item.title: 5,050 bottles of cough syrup seized in Bargarh
item.description: Bargarh: Acting on a tip-off, Town Police in Bargarh seized 5,050 bottles of cough syrup and arrested six persons, including a woman, during a raid at an under-construction building near Bargarh-Katapali Road Wednesday. item.title: Listed ‘dead’ in Aadhaar, farmer fails to sell paddy
item.description: Bargarh: In a bizarre and a striking incident of Aadhaar goof-up, a farmer from Bijepur area in this district was deprived of selling his harvested paddy as his Aadhaar record erroneously showed him as ‘dead’.
